name: listing-issues
description: Fixes listing problems that surface as reported issues on a listing — missing or invalid attributes, and suppressions tied to an issue. Reads the listing's issues (severity + enforcement), prioritizes by impact, and previews every fix before it goes live. Triggers on: listing issues, listing errors, fix my listing, attribute errors, suppressed because of an issue, "what's wrong with this listing". Do NOT use for: why a listing isn't buyable when there's no issue (use listing-buyability), search visibility / optimization (use listing-searchability), creating new listings, inventory / stockout, advertising, or orders.
